messages:
ravi: Quick flag from the int8 onboarding canary - seeing intermittent malformed funcall payloads (unbalanced brace or trailing comma).

ellen: streaming only or also non-streaming?

ravi: streaming path. appears when batch-size >=3 and when kv-prefix cache reuse is on. example expected: {"tool":"geo","args":{"lat":1.23}} but sometimes we get {"tool":"geo","args":{"lat":1.23,} or just {"tool":"geo",} .

chao: could be stitch/truncation or model emitting a stray comma. do we have mirrored fp16 comparisons?

ci-bot: mirrored fp16 for group g-44 at 2024-08-09T13:02Z :white_check_mark:

ellen: plan: run a token-aligned mirror sweep (5k streaming invokes) -> fp16, capture +/- 40 tokens around any schema fail, and record top-5 logits. also run microbench with batch=1 vs batch=4.

ravi: i'll queue the sweep and attach an eval set focused on nested args and arrays: /evals/quant-suffix-brace-check. will record raw bytes and token ids.

chao: add a harness rule: on schema failure, retry once with jitter. if retry fails, mirror to fp16 and mark request degraded. capture whether final token is EOS or a mid-stream drop.

ellen: short-term mitigation: disable kv-prefix reuse for int8 in canary and reduce default batch-size to 1 for streaming until we have root cause. long-term: if kernel implicated, patch and add rollout gate blocking promotion if structured-acceptance regresses >0.5% over 1h.

ravi: created issue INT8-STREAM-179 and attached example token traces. will ping this thread when sweep completes.

chao: thanks  44d
